LightningComponentBundle.description: One related list on a record page, drawn at once as a table in the house style, with its count, the columns the page asks for, links to each record and View all.

property.name: relatedListId
property.label: Related list
property.description: The child relationship, as the related list is named: Contacts, Cases, Coverages__r.

property.name: childObject
property.label: Child object
property.description: API name of the object the rows are, which qualifies the field names.

property.name: fields
property.label: Columns
property.description: Comma-separated columns, each FieldPath|Header|kind. Kinds: link, lookup, money, date, chip, number, percent, text. The first three stay when the list is narrow.

property.name: sortBy
property.label: Sort by
property.description: Fields on the child object, comma-separated, each with a leading - for newest or largest first.

property.name: note
property.label: Note
property.description: One line under the title saying how to read the list.

property.name: rows
property.label: Rows
property.description: How many rows to show before View all.

property.name: icon
property.label: Row icon
property.description: An icon ahead of each row's name, from the shared mapping: kind:FieldPath when it depends on the row (asset:Asset_Type__c, role:Role__c, line:Line_of_Business__c, coverage:Name, kind:Kind__c), or a kind alone (person, sale, quote).

property.name: parentField
property.label: Lookup to this record
property.description: The lookup on the child that points at this record. When set, the list offers New.

property.name: through
property.label: List of the record at
property.description: The lookup on this page's record to the record whose list this is, for a list one step up: Policy__c on an insured asset's page shows the policy's list.

property.name: mergeBy
property.label: Merge rows
property.description: GroupPath|JoinPath. Rows that share the record at the end of GroupPath become one row, with the values of JoinPath joined by commas.

property.name: emptyText
property.label: Empty text
property.description: What to say when there are no rows.
